lines: [urgent, to camera] This just happened to Penny. Watch closely.
[serious] A text from 'her bank'. Suspicious charge. Call this number.
She called. The 'bank' knew her name and the last four digits of her card.
[slow] Then they told her to move her money to a 'safe account'.
[firm] Real banks never ask you to move money to keep it safe.
[counting] Three rules. Hang up. Call the number on your card. Never move money for anyone.
